newsitem.title: INDIA: India TELCO 97/98 Q1 sales down 12.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: India TELCO 97/98 Q1 sales down 12.5 pct.

text.p: Sales of India's biggest truck-maker Tata Engineering & Locomotive Company Ltd. (TELCO) have fallen 12.50 percent in the first quarter ending June 30, 1997, a company spokesperson told Reuters on Wednesday.
The spokesperson did not give details.
TELCO is due to hold its annual general meeting at 3.30 p.m. (1000 GMT) later on Wednesday.
The Economic Times on Wednesday said TELCO has planned a 45 billion rupees ($1.26 billion) capital expenditure plan for the next three years.

The daily said 52 percent of the capital expenditure plan will be generated through internal accruals, 16 percent from equity and foreign and domestic debt contributing 24 and 8.0 percent respectively. ($1 = 35.7 rupees)
